company.name: Rive, Inc.
company.shortDescription: Rive is a real-time animation software provider.
company.description: Rive is transforming the way designers and developers collaborate by allowing them to create animated interactive experiences that run faster, store smaller, and use less memory than existing design solutions. This new workflow allows designers and developers to concentrate on what they do best, eliminating the need for a complex handoff. Graphics such as animated UI, characters, heads-up displays, hero moments, buttons, icons, and emojis can be iterated on freely by creative teams. Rive saves businesses time and engineering resources by enabling designers to create interactive content from concept to production.
